correctness.rationale: Prue–Scrimshaw Theorem 3.2 applies after one bisection of each edge. The exact incidence check exhausts the cubical model and deletes only free square–cube pairs. The remaining connected two-dimensional subcomplex is a deformation retract. Its Euler characteristic and Ko–Park's integral first-homology formula give nonzero free second homology, proving dimension two is minimal. The exact replay is python3 verify.py.
